WITH m AS (
  SELECT zoneref, facetregistry,
    (mesh_specs->>'Facet_Faces')::numeric / ((mesh_specs->>'Facet_Verts')::numeric * power((mesh_specs->>'Facet_Res_Mm')::numeric, 2)) * 1000 AS mcr,
    (mesh_specs->>'Facet_Res_Mm')::numeric AS res,
    (mesh_specs->>'Geom_Delta_Mm')::numeric AS geo
  FROM mesh
), a AS (
  SELECT s.zoneregistry, s.zonelabel,
    COUNT(m.facetregistry) AS total_meshes,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE m.mcr > 5.0 AND m.res < 1.0 AND m.geo < 0.5) AS hf_meshes,
    AVG(m.mcr) AS avg_mcr, AVG(m.res) AS avg_res, AVG(m.geo) AS avg_geo
  FROM sites s LEFT JOIN m ON m.zoneref = s.zoneregistry
  GROUP BY s.zoneregistry, s.zonelabel
)
SELECT zoneregistry AS site_code, zonelabel AS site_name, total_meshes, hf_meshes,
  ROUND(CASE WHEN total_meshes > 0 THEN hf_meshes * 100.0 / total_meshes ELSE 0 END, 2) AS hf_percentage,
  ROUND(avg_mcr, 2) AS avg_mcr, ROUND(avg_res, 2) AS avg_resolution_mm, ROUND(avg_geo, 2) AS avg_geometric_accuracy_mm,
  CASE WHEN hf_meshes > 0 THEN 'Has High-Fidelity Meshes'
       WHEN total_meshes > 0 THEN 'Standard Mesh Quality'
       ELSE 'No Mesh Data' END AS mesh_quality_classification
FROM a
ORDER BY hf_percentage DESC

WITH r AS (
  SELECT r.logregistry, r.arcref,
    (r.reg_accuracy->>'Log_Accu_Mm')::numeric AS acc,
    (r.reg_accuracy->>'Err_Val_Mm')::numeric AS err,
    r.reg_accuracy->>'Log_Method' AS method,
    (p.cloud_metrics->>'Scan_Resol_Mm')::numeric AS res
  FROM registration r JOIN pointcloud p ON p.arcref = r.arcref AND p.crewref = r.crewref
), x AS (
  SELECT *, res / (acc * sqrt(1 + err/acc)) AS rar FROM r
)
SELECT logregistry AS registration_id, arcref AS project_id, acc AS registration_accuracy_mm, err AS error_value_mm,
  ROUND(rar, 2) AS rar,
  CASE WHEN rar > 1.5 AND method LIKE '%Target%' THEN 'High Confidence'
       WHEN rar BETWEEN 1.0 AND 1.5 THEN 'Medium Confidence'
       ELSE 'Low Confidence' END AS confidence_level
FROM x
ORDER BY rar DESC

SELECT s.zoneregistry AS site_code, s.zonelabel AS site_name,
  ROUND(AVG(100 - 2.5*abs((e.ambient_cond->>'Ambic_Temp')::numeric - 20)
    - power(abs(((e.ambient_cond->>'Hume_Pct')::numeric - 50)/2), 1.5)
    - 600/((e.ambient_cond->>'Illume_Lux')::numeric + 100)), 2) AS avg_esi
FROM sites s JOIN environment e ON e.zoneref = s.zoneregistry
GROUP BY s.zoneregistry, s.zonelabel
ORDER BY avg_esi DESC

SELECT s.zoneregistry AS site_code, s.zonelabel AS site_name,
  c.structstate AS structural_state, s.site_status->>'Pres_Stat' AS preservation_status,
  CASE WHEN (s.site_status->>'Pres_Stat' LIKE '%Poor%' OR s.site_status->>'Pres_Stat' LIKE '%Critical%')
        AND c.structstate NOT LIKE '%Stable%'
       THEN 'Degradation Risk Zone' ELSE 'Not in Risk Zone' END AS risk_zone_category
FROM sites s JOIN conservation c ON c.zoneref = s.zoneregistry
note: Lists all sites joined to conservation records with their category; structural state taken from conservation.structstate.

WITH pc AS (
  SELECT sc.zoneref,
    (p.cloud_metrics->>'Scan_Resol_Mm')::numeric AS res,
    (p.cloud_metrics->>'Point_Dense')::numeric AS dens,
    (p.cloud_metrics->>'Cover_Pct')::numeric AS cov,
    (p.cloud_metrics->>'Lap_Pct')::numeric AS lap,
    (p.cloud_metrics->>'Noise_Db')::numeric AS noise,
    (r.reg_accuracy->>'Log_Accu_Mm')::numeric AS acc,
    (r.reg_accuracy->>'Err_Val_Mm')::numeric AS err
  FROM scans sc
  JOIN pointcloud p ON p.arcref = sc.arcref AND p.crewref = sc.crewref
  LEFT JOIN registration r ON r.arcref = sc.arcref AND r.crewref = sc.crewref
), pcm AS (
  SELECT zoneref,
    AVG(power(10 / (log(res*1000) / log(dens) * 5), 1.5)
        * (cov * (1 + lap/100 * (1 - cov/100)) / 100)
        * power(1 - noise/30, 2)) AS sqs,
    AVG(cov * (1 + lap/100 * (1 - cov/100))) AS sce,
    AVG(noise) AS noise,
    AVG(res / (acc * sqrt(1 + err/acc))) AS rar,
    AVG(err) AS err,
    AVG(res) AS res
  FROM pc GROUP BY zoneref
), mm AS (
  SELECT zoneref,
    AVG( ((mesh_specs->>'Facet_Faces')::numeric / ((mesh_specs->>'Facet_Verts')::numeric * power((mesh_specs->>'Facet_Res_Mm')::numeric, 2)) * 1000)
       * (((mesh_specs->>'Tex_Pix')::numeric / (sqrt((mesh_specs->>'Facet_Faces')::numeric) * (mesh_specs->>'Facet_Res_Mm')::numeric) * 0.01) / 10)
       * (1 + exp(-(mesh_specs->>'Geom_Delta_Mm')::numeric)) ) AS mfs
  FROM mesh GROUP BY zoneref
), d AS (
  SELECT s.zoneregistry, s.zonelabel, pcm.*, mm.mfs,
    (pcm.sqs*0.4 + mm.mfs*0.4 + pcm.sce*0.2 - 5*sqrt(pcm.noise/10)) AS adc
  FROM sites s JOIN pcm ON pcm.zoneref = s.zoneregistry JOIN mm ON mm.zoneref = s.zoneregistry
)
SELECT zoneregistry AS site_code, zonelabel AS site_name,
  ROUND(0.3*adc + 0.3*mfs + 0.2*rar + 0.2*sce - 2*sqrt(err/res), 2) AS dpq
FROM d
WHERE rar IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY dpq DESC
note: Site-level DPQ from per-site averages; pointcloud/registration linked to scans via (arcref, crewref).

WITH b AS (
  SELECT s.zoneregistry,
    (pc.cloud_metrics->>'Total_Pts')::numeric AS pts,
    (pc.cloud_metrics->>'Cloud_Dense')::numeric AS cd,
    (sp.spatial_dims->>'Area_M2')::numeric AS area,
    (f.feature_analysis->>'Trait_Count')::numeric AS traits,
    (f.feature_analysis->>'Arti_Count')::numeric AS artis
  FROM sites s
  LEFT JOIN scans sc ON sc.zoneref = s.zoneregistry
  LEFT JOIN pointcloud pc ON pc.arcref = sc.arcref AND pc.crewref = sc.crewref
  LEFT JOIN spatial sp ON sp.arcref = sc.arcref AND sp.crewref = sc.crewref
  LEFT JOIN features f ON f.zoneref = s.zoneregistry
), x AS (
  SELECT zoneregistry, pts / NULLIF(cd * area, 0) AS pcdr, cd, traits, artis FROM b
)
SELECT zoneregistry AS site_code,
  ROUND(AVG(pcdr), 2) AS avg_pcdr,
  ROUND(AVG((traits + artis) / NULLIF(pcdr * sqrt(cd), 0) * 1000), 2) AS avg_fee
FROM x
GROUP BY zoneregistry
ORDER BY avg_fee DESC NULLS LAST

WITH pr AS (
  SELECT p.flowregistry,
    CASE
      WHEN lower(p.flowsoft) IN ('agi.','agi','agisoft','agisoft metashape','metashape') THEN 'Agisoft'
      WHEN lower(p.flowsoft) IN ('c.c.','cc','cloud compare','cloudcompare') THEN 'CloudCompare'
      WHEN lower(p.flowsoft) IN ('geo.','geo','geomagic','geomagic studio') THEN 'Geomagic'
      WHEN lower(p.flowsoft) IN ('r.c.','rc','reality capture','realitycapture') THEN 'RealityCapture'
      ELSE p.flowsoft END AS software,
    p.flowstage AS stage,
    (p.system_usage->>'Flow_Hrs')::numeric AS hrs,
    (p.system_usage->>'Proc_CPU')::numeric AS cpu,
    (p.system_usage->>'Proc_GPU')::numeric AS gpu,
    split_part(sc.size, ' ', 1)::numeric AS gb,
    (pc.cloud_metrics->>'Total_Pts')::numeric AS pts
  FROM processing p
  JOIN scans sc ON sc.zoneref = p.zoneref
  JOIN pointcloud pc ON pc.arcref = sc.arcref AND pc.crewref = sc.crewref
), x AS (
  SELECT *, (gb * log(pts)) / (hrs * (cpu + gpu) / 200) AS per FROM pr
), g AS (
  SELECT software, stage, AVG(hrs) AS avg_hrs, AVG(cpu) AS avg_cpu, AVG(gpu) AS avg_gpu, AVG(gb) AS avg_gb,
    AVG(per) AS avg_per, COUNT(DISTINCT flowregistry) AS workflow_count
  FROM x GROUP BY software, stage
)
SELECT software, stage, ROUND(avg_hrs,1) AS avg_processing_hours, ROUND(avg_cpu,1) AS avg_cpu_usage,
  ROUND(avg_gpu,1) AS avg_gpu_usage, ROUND(avg_gb,1) AS avg_data_size_gb, ROUND(avg_per,1) AS avg_per,
  CASE WHEN avg_per < 0.5 THEN 'Bottleneck Detected' ELSE 'Efficient' END AS efficiency_status,
  workflow_count
FROM g
ORDER BY CASE WHEN avg_per < 0.5 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, avg_per ASC

WITH e AS (
  SELECT zoneref,
    (ambient_cond->>'Ambic_Temp')::numeric AS t,
    (ambient_cond->>'Hume_Pct')::numeric AS h,
    (ambient_cond->>'Illume_Lux')::numeric AS lux
  FROM environment
), x AS (
  SELECT zoneref, t, h, lux,
    100 - 2.5*abs(t-20) - power(abs((h-50)/2), 1.5) - 600/(lux+100) AS esi
  FROM e
), a AS (
  SELECT s.zoneregistry AS site_code, s.zonelabel AS site_name,
    AVG(x.t) AS avg_temp, AVG(x.h) AS avg_humidity, AVG(x.lux) AS avg_illumination, AVG(x.esi) AS avg_esi
  FROM sites s JOIN x ON x.zoneref = s.zoneregistry
  GROUP BY s.zoneregistry, s.zonelabel
)
SELECT site_code, site_name, ROUND(avg_temp,1) AS avg_temperature, ROUND(avg_humidity,1) AS avg_humidity,
  ROUND(avg_illumination,1) AS avg_illumination, ROUND(avg_esi,1) AS avg_esi,
  NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY avg_esi) AS esi_quartile,
  CASE WHEN avg_esi > 85 THEN 'Optimal Scanning Conditions'
       WHEN avg_esi > 70 THEN 'Good Scanning Conditions'
       WHEN avg_esi > 50 THEN 'Acceptable Scanning Conditions'
       ELSE 'Challenging Scanning Conditions' END AS environmental_condition
FROM a
ORDER BY avg_esi DESC

WITH m AS (
  SELECT sc.zoneref,
    (p.cloud_metrics->>'Scan_Resol_Mm')::numeric AS res,
    (p.cloud_metrics->>'Point_Dense')::numeric AS dens,
    (p.cloud_metrics->>'Cover_Pct')::numeric AS cov,
    (p.cloud_metrics->>'Lap_Pct')::numeric AS lap,
    (p.cloud_metrics->>'Noise_Db')::numeric AS noise
  FROM scans sc JOIN pointcloud p ON p.arcref = sc.arcref AND p.crewref = sc.crewref
), q AS (
  SELECT zoneref,
    power(10 / (log(res*1000) / log(dens) * 5), 1.5)
    * (cov * (1 + lap/100 * (1 - cov/100)) / 100)
    * power(1 - noise/30, 2) AS sqs
  FROM m
)
SELECT s.zoneregistry AS site_code, s.zonelabel AS site_name, ROUND(AVG(q.sqs), 2) AS avg_sqs
FROM sites s JOIN q ON q.zoneref = s.zoneregistry
GROUP BY s.zoneregistry, s.zonelabel
ORDER BY avg_sqs DESC

WITH b AS (
  SELECT e.equipregistry,
    (p.system_usage->>'Flow_Hrs')::numeric AS hrs,
    (p.system_usage->>'Proc_CPU')::numeric AS cpu,
    (p.system_usage->>'Proc_GPU')::numeric AS gpu,
    split_part(sc.size, ' ', 1)::numeric AS gb,
    (m.mesh_specs->>'Facet_Verts')::numeric AS verts
  FROM equipment e
  LEFT JOIN processing p ON p.equipref = e.equipregistry
  LEFT JOIN mesh m ON m.equipref = p.equipref AND m.zoneref = p.zoneref
  LEFT JOIN scans sc ON sc.zoneref = p.zoneref
), x AS (
  SELECT *, (hrs * (cpu + gpu) / 2) / NULLIF(gb * 10 * log(verts + 10000), 0) AS pru FROM b
), g AS (
  SELECT equipregistry, AVG(pru) AS pru, AVG(hrs) AS avg_hrs, AVG(cpu) AS avg_cpu, AVG(gpu) AS avg_gpu
  FROM x GROUP BY equipregistry
)
SELECT equipregistry AS equipment_id,
  ROUND(pru, 2) AS pru,
  ROUND(avg_hrs, 2) AS avg_processing_hours,
  RANK() OVER (ORDER BY pru ASC NULLS LAST) AS efficiency_rank,
  CASE WHEN pru < 5.0 THEN 'Optimized'
       WHEN pru <= 10.0 THEN 'Acceptable'
       ELSE 'Needs Optimization' END AS workflow_efficiency_status,
  json_build_object('cpu_usage', ROUND(avg_cpu, 2), 'gpu_usage', ROUND(avg_gpu, 2), 'processing_hours', ROUND(avg_hrs, 2)) AS resource_details
FROM g
ORDER BY pru ASC NULLS LAST
note: Mesh vertices via mesh on (equipref, zoneref), file size via scans on zoneref; equipment with no PRU fall to Needs Optimization.
